_original_lore: The Voracious Spider is a spider that spawns in
the Spider's Den. Unlike regular spiders in the Den
they have much more health and damage output
and spawn much more frequently in large groups.
name: 贪食蜘蛛 (怪物)

source: The Voracious Spider is a spider that spawns in
the Spider's Den. Unlike regular spiders in the Den
they have much more health and damage output
and spawn much more frequently in large groups.
loreParagraphs.translation: 贪食蜘蛛是生成在蜘蛛巢穴中的蜘蛛.与巢穴中的普通蜘蛛不同,它们拥有更多的生命值和伤害输出,并且更频繁地成群生成.
